live.empty: No logs yet. Run a test to see execution logs.

live.liveToggleTooltip:
On: show logs live, as they happen, with no animation.
Off: slow the canvas animation and logs down for clarity.
live.orphaned: This test was started before the page was reopened, so its live logs are no longer available. Please stop the test and run it again to see the logs.
